objectives.statement: Use hvis, dersom, and om to introduce hypothetical condition clauses.
Use ville, skulle, and hadde to express unreal or tentative meaning without a special subjunctive form.
Recognize and form natural inverted conditionals such as Hadde jeg tid.
Diagnose common English-transfer errors in Norwegian irrealis sentences.

notes: Must teach hypothetical and contrary-to-fact meanings through modals and clause structure, including hvis/dersom/om clauses, inverted conditionals where natural, and no productive Norwegian subjunctive.
